stage: Stage 2C - Shared Engine VFX Primitive & Set-Piece Library

assets.name: Clobber Kinetic Impact Burst
assets.artAsset: Procedural canvas/shader star + 3 gouache impact smear frames
assets.summary: Universal physical hit burst parameterized by hit count (1-7), scale, dust puff, and shield-piercing crack overlay. Handles every Basic, multi-hit flurry, and physical Capstone.
assets.params: { targetIds, hits: 1..7, intervalMs: 110, scale: 0.8..1.8, pierceShield: bool, color: "#d97706" }

assets.name: Sizzle Heat Wave & Burn Embers
assets.artAsset: Tiled storybook ember particles + warm orange-crimson wave gradient
assets.summary: Sweeping heat distortion wave, rising cinnamon/kiln steam, Toasty ember rings, Five-Alarm Burn flame upgrades, and instant double burn-tick pop bursts.
assets.params: { scope: "single"|"aoe"|"dual", applyToasty: bool, fiveAlarm: bool, triggerTicks: 0..2 }

assets.name: Drench Splash, Mist & Droplet Spray
assets.artAsset: Hand-painted water fan sprites + glossy droplet particles (tintable)
assets.summary: Tintable liquid splash primitive supporting Windex blue mist, bubbly sourdough beige foam, iced cold brew, wine pour, 360-degree wet-dog shake spray, and nursery cool-mist clouds.

assets.name: Razzle Voltage Arc, Beam & Glitter
assets.artAsset: Additive jagged lightning polyline + spotlight cone + sparkle sprites
assets.summary: Covers voltage-tester sparks, copper banner links, 240V chain-lightning splashes, flashlight/camera LED beams, neon glitter ribbons, and Dazzled sparkle icons.

assets.name: Racket Sonic Rings & Callout Waves
assets.artAsset: Concentric ink-stroked ellipses (smooth, jagged violin, 5-beat clap, 110dB cone)
assets.summary: Expanding acoustic rings for VIP pass flick reverberations, sugar-cube crunch, Rikers bark, 5-beat teacher clap, violin screech, dad-sneeze, raspberry, hot-mic feedback, and Broadway vocal belt.

assets.name: All 6 v11 Prime -> Detonation Bursts
assets.artAsset: 6 hand-lettered comic-storybook pop callouts + matching elemental ring
assets.summary: Shared global combat payoff VFX for Steam Cloud! (blind mist), Panic Boil! (guard drop), Hydro-Slip! (25% push), Short Circuit! (40% splash), Shatter Glitz! (buff strip), and Sensory Overload! (-25% Atk).

assets.name: Composure Pip Shatter & Flustered Banner
assets.artAsset: Cracking porcelain pip shards + swirling Flustered dizzy stars
assets.summary: Fires whenever a move shaves 1-4 Composure pips; escalates into a full dramatic shatter-ring and Flustered slowdown banner when pips hit 0.

assets.name: Emerald Heal, Regen, Cleanse & Revive
assets.artAsset: Rising emerald-gold leaf/sparkle rings + vertical revive pillar
assets.summary: Handles single/party heals (5%-100%), overheal-to-Clean-Bill-Shield conversion glow, rising debuff-dissolve sparks, and vertical revive beams (25% Pick-Me-Up, 40% Waymo, 80% Moon).
assets.params: { targetIds, healPct: 5..100, cleanse: bool, isRevive: bool, overhealShield: bool }

assets.name: Ally Shield, Carapace, Drywall & Ward Shell
assets.artAsset: 6 swappable barrier skins over 1 unified shield-shell controller
assets.summary: Unified defensive overlay supporting Velvet Stanchion, Pottery Wheel Clay -> Fired Glaze, Gypsum Drywall, Cozy Jacket Wrap, Golden Bread Crust, Mom-Arm Seatbelt Bar, and Plushie Self-Shield.

assets.name: Timeline Push, Pull, Swap & Pep/Ruckus Pop
assets.artAsset: Crisp directional chevrons (teal forward, red back) + gold Pep stars
assets.summary: Immediately communicates timeline manipulation (10%-35% pushback, 15%-30% turn pull, 25-tick swap, bonus mini-turn ring) plus +1/+2 Pep stars and +20%/+25% Family Ruckus surge arcs.

assets.name: Stat Buff/Debuff, Strip, Invert & Taunt Tether
assets.artAsset: Crisp 3-icon screen-rule badges, buff-flip orb, taunt line, 4-tab mark
assets.summary: Handles Eyes On Me spotlight, aggro tethers, buff-strip shatter orbs, buff-steal flight arcs, Fact-Check buff inversion flips, 4-Tab Mix markers, forced Razzle Pet Peeve badge, and permanent Def-crack fissures.

assets.name: Lobbed Projectile Arc Engine
assets.artAsset: 1 parabolic flight controller + 10 small 64px prop sprites
assets.summary: Drives parabolic right-to-left projectile travel with spin, shadow projection, and impact trigger. Swaps sprite for wet clay, chili seeds, 1989 Mason jar, yellow penalty flag, buttered popcorn, and 80-lb toolbox.
assets.params: { spriteId, startPos, endPos, arcHeightPx: 45..110, spinSpeed, impactVfxId }

assets.name: Boomerang & Fishing-Line Pull Engine
assets.artAsset: 1 out-and-back curve controller + 4 small prop sprites + taut line renderer
assets.summary: Handles out-and-back projectiles that physically bonk the enemy at t=0.5 and curve cleanly back to the caster's hand (soup dumpling, wrist-strap controller, tattered Lamby, and Boppy's pier fishing line + lure).
assets.params: { spriteId, hasLine: bool, pullTargetToFront: bool, apexTimeFrac: 0.5 }

assets.name: Ally Toss & Party Snack Distribution Engine
assets.artAsset: 1 gentle right-side arc controller + 6 cozy item sprites
assets.summary: Arcs tangible items directly from caster into one or all four ally slots (neon NeeDoh ball, frosted cinnamon roll, diaper-bag snacks, dairy-free snack pack, warm apple muffins from 12-cup tin, rental e-bike chirp).

assets.name: Persistent Ground Hazard & Lava Floor Engine
assets.artAsset: 3 animated floor decals (soapy suds + cone, hot-glue rhinestones, bubbling lava + cushions)
assets.summary: Renders perspective-matched floor overlays beneath enemy feet for multi-turn traps and floor-is-lava sequences: Wet-Floor soapy slick, Bedazzle-Gun hot-glue rhinestone mat, bubbling molten lava under floating sofa cushions, and Skateboard rolling debris.

assets.name: Delta 360 Black Tarmac Porsche SUV
assets.artAsset: Hand-painted 2D side-3/4 Porsche SUV sprite + additive LED headlight cones
assets.summary: Screeches right-to-left across the enemy half of the clearing with blinding LED high-beams and swirling jet-wash rings for Tom's Frequent Flier Capstone.

assets.name: Delta One Privacy-Pod Sliding Doors
assets.artAsset: Left/right sliding charcoal-and-silver cabin panels + amber lock LEDs
assets.summary: Materializes and physically glides shut around adjacent allies during Suite Door Slide, clicking cabin lock lights on with redirect tethers back to Tom.

assets.name: Giant Sky-Dropped Floor Controller (Konami Code)
assets.artAsset: Oversized perspective floor retro controller + 10 lit button glow overlays + retro meteors
assets.summary: Drops from the sky beneath Tom's sneakers so he can hop across the oversized D-pad and B/A buttons reciting the Konami Code, then fires rainbow starbeams and retro meteors across all foes.

assets.name: Three-Tier Showstopper Cake Cart
assets.artAsset: Hand-painted 3-tier frosted cake on rolling dessert cart + animated sparkler candles
assets.summary: Rolls onto the party side blazing with golden sparkler candles to heal, cleanse, and infuse all allies' next attacks with Sizzle embers.

assets.name: Colossal Sky-Steamer & Diamond-Gold Dumpling
assets.artAsset: Giant bamboo steamer lid at top of screen + house-sized sparkling gold soup dumpling
assets.summary: Unlatches overhead to drop a house-sized Sparkling Diamond-Gold Soup Dumpling onto the chosen ally, bouncing softly with golden Pep bursts to grant a free skill.

assets.name: Giant Wooden Easel & Neon Portrait Reveal
assets.artAsset: Tall storybook easel + pulling velvet drape + exploding watercolor & gem wave
assets.summary: Flips open beside Grace as velvet falls away, blasting neon watercolor waves and craft gems into the target enemy to force a temporary Razzle Pet Peeve.

assets.name: Broadway Spotlights & Flashbulb Rig
assets.artAsset: 3 converging additive spotlight cones + popping white camera flashbulb stars
assets.summary: Dims the clearing slightly while sweeping three golden theatre spotlights onto Grace's soaring split-leap triple-twist dismount and popping flashbulbs at impact.

assets.name: Sofa-Cushion Citadel & Twin-Lamby Lookouts
assets.artAsset: Stacked quilted cushions & blankets wall + miniature tattered & Backup Lamby lookouts
assets.summary: Assembles a sturdy living-room pillow fort spanning all four party slots with both Lambies perched on top as lookouts blocking timeline pushback.

assets.name: Star-Lit Kingdom of Ten-Thousand Blankets
assets.artAsset: Patchwork quilt castle + warm fairy string lights + giant twin-Lamby plushie guardians
assets.summary: Rises behind the party bathed in warm twinkling string lights to deliver a 60% ally heal and full cleanse before rolling an AoE Sizzle warmth wave left.

assets.name: Trampoline-Sized Pink Whoopee Cushion
assets.artAsset: Giant neon-pink rubber cushion sliding under enemy formation + tuba shockwave rings
assets.summary: Slides smoothly under all enemies and detonates in an earth-shaking tuba-blasting PFFFFRT! shockwave that shatters active stances and drops enemy Attack.

assets.name: Full-House 8-Seat Sunday Dinner Table
assets.artAsset: Candlelit 8-seat wooden family table (plus 1 extra chair!) with warm roast glow
assets.summary: Glides across the party side for 2 full rounds, bathing every teammate in candlelight so each ally turn opens with 15% heal, +1 Pep, and a random stat boost.

assets.name: Rising Full Moon & Moonlight Embrace
assets.artAsset: Luminous painted silver-gold full moon rising over treeline + dual heal/Sizzle wave
assets.summary: Lifts a radiant full moon above the clearing for Deedee's To the Moon & Back Capstone: 80% revive / 100% heal on target ally + warm AoE Sizzle shockwave (-2 Composure).

assets.name: Fifty-Year Sparkling Soapy Tsunami
assets.artAsset: Towering hand-painted cresting suds wave + sparkling lemon-cleanse particles
assets.summary: Surges right-to-left across the entire enemy clearing, scrubbing away all enemy hazards, buffs, and stealth while leaving every foe gleaming and Drenched.

assets.name: Gleaming Brass-and-Iron Rikers Warden Gates
assets.artAsset: Heavy ornate iron gate bars slamming down in front of party + metallic thorn glint
assets.summary: Thunders down vertically in front of all four party slots for 2 rounds (-40% AoE damage taken + Clobber melee thorns) as Boppy slams his brass keys.

assets.name: Cattail Pier Pilings, Swells & Breaching Catch (NO BOAT)
assets.artAsset: Weathered wooden pier pilings + folding shore chair + surging swells + Striper & Whale-Sized Leviathan
assets.summary: Strictly honors the NO-BOAT canon lock: anchors weathered Cattail Pier pilings and a shore folding chair on Boppy's edge while Long Island Sound swells surge on the left for both Trophy Striper Haul and the whale-sized Leviathan breach.

assets.name: Sentient Back-Garden Ghost Pepper
assets.artAsset: Glowing crimson ghost pepper sprite with squinting ember-eyes + roaring flame cone
assets.summary: Floats forward off Boppy's open palm and unleashes a massive roaring cone of Sizzle fire that triggers 2 full burn ticks across all foes without consuming burns.

assets.name: Leaning Museum-Sized Grand Terracotta Amphora
assets.artAsset: Tall Pisa-leaning terracotta amphora (intact, cracked-1, shattered glazed shard burst)
assets.summary: Rises calmly between the formations to absorb 2 hits before shattering outward across every foe in razor-sharp glazed Clobber and Razzle shards (-2 Composure).

assets.name: Autonomous Waymo SUV & LA Metro Express Train
assets.artAsset: White Waymo SUV (spinning roof lidar + opening door) + sleek LA Metro rail car
assets.summary: Two iconic car-free LA transit set-pieces for TNB Longboarder: the white Waymo SUV lidar-blinding foes while opening its door for a 40% revive, and the gleaming LA Metro train rushing alongside steep Baxter Street lines.

assets.name: Ornate Eighth Wooden Dining Chair
assets.artAsset: Hand-painted wooden family dining chair with cushion + regal gold decree rings
assets.summary: Slides cleanly beneath Nara so she can hop onto her own human seat on all four paws and bark her pie-crust decree (-1 Composure all foes, party mental cleanse, +20% pull).

assets.name: Stadium Jumbotron Instant Replay Screen
assets.artAsset: Hanging stadium LED scoreboard with glowing VHS rewind arrows + golden penalty beam
assets.summary: Drops above the meadow for Justin's Armchair Ref Capstone, visibly rewinding 50% of the last ally hit taken while slamming the offending monster with a -25% Def Racket penalty beam.

assets.name: 6'4" Michael Toddler Sprint & LivNews Chopper
assets.artAsset: Michael sprinting sprite scooping Lachlan & Isla + sliding dinner tray | LivNews chopper + searchlights + red ticker
assets.summary: Olivia's two signature large-scale set-pieces: 6'4" Michael sprinting across the field to startle foes (-25% bar) while sliding hot dinner to the party, and the LivNews chopper sweeping twin searchlights with a BREAKING NEWS ticker.

assets.name: Neon Gym Bleachers Pyro & 100% Family Ruckus Crest
assets.artAsset: Treeline gym bleachers + golden pyro fountains | Prismatic storybook Family Ruckus crest
assets.summary: Shared climactic arena overlays: neon championship gym bleachers and pyro for Olivia's Rope Champ Capstone, plus the 50% Double Team link flash and 100% Full Family Ruckus storybook crest.
